question: Which grower had the largest total shortfall across the 2023 to 2025 seasons? Give the grower's name.

question: On average, how many days passed between consecutive inspections of the same hive in 2025? Use only pairs of inspections that both took place in 2025, count whole calendar days between the inspection dates, and round to 1 decimal place.

question: Which yard had the highest share of tested 2025 inspections over the mite treatment threshold? Count each inspection under the hive's home yard and give the yard code.
SQL: SELECT y.c_fv22 FROM t_945w i JOIN t_8jk7 h ON h.k_hkv6 = i.k_hkv6 JOIN t_8zf7 y ON y.k_ngt6 = h.k_ngt6 WHERE i.c_dmc9 IS NOT NULL AND i.c_5mfp >= '2025-01-01' AND i.c_5mfp < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(CASE WHEN i.c_dmc9 > 9 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the net revenue per hive delivered for the 2025 season, in dollars? Round to 2 decimal places.
SQL: SELECT round((SELECT sum(v.c_rdk7 * (1 - v.c_p5f2 / 10000.0)) / 100 FROM t_r77r v JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = v.k_gw37 WHERE v.c_j45j = 0 AND k.c_q592 = 2025) / (SELECT count(*) FROM t_p47h p JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = p.k_gw37 WHERE k.c_q592 = 2025), 2)

question: For each cooperative whose members brought in net revenue for the 2024 season, how much did they bring in? List the cooperative name and the amount in dollars rounded to 2 decimal places.
SQL: SELECT co.c_qp3g, round(sum(v.c_rdk7 * (1 - v.c_p5f2 / 10000.0)) / 100, 2) FROM t_r77r v JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = v.k_gw37 JOIN t_8xjv m ON m.k_fj35 = k.k_fj35 JOIN t_8xjv co ON co.k_fj35 = m.c_9dfh WHERE v.c_j45j = 0 AND k.c_q592 = 2024 GROUP BY co.k_fj35, 1

question: Which crop had the highest average price per hive in the 2025 season, excluding cancelled contracts? Give the crop name.
SQL: SELECT c.c_352q FROM t_kk9b k JOIN t_3mgb b ON b.k_8r54 = k.k_8r54 JOIN t_z66c c ON c.k_q4xd = b.k_q4xd WHERE k.c_q592 = 2025 AND k.c_zj29 <> 5 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(k.c_6jv8) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Among growers with net revenue in both the 2024 and 2025 seasons, how many brought in more in 2025 than in 2024?
SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT k.k_fj35, sum(v.c_rdk7 * (1 - v.c_p5f2 / 10000.0)) FILTER (WHERE k.c_q592 = 2024) AS a, sum(v.c_rdk7 * (1 - v.c_p5f2 / 10000.0)) FILTER (WHERE k.c_q592 = 2025) AS b FROM t_r77r v JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = v.k_gw37 WHERE v.c_j45j = 0 GROUP BY 1) x WHERE a IS NOT NULL AND b IS NOT NULL AND b > a

question: In which month of 2025 were the most tested inspections over the mite treatment threshold? Give the month number.
SQL: SELECT extract(month FROM c_5mfp)::int FROM t_945w WHERE c_dmc9 > 9 AND c_5mfp >= '2025-01-01' AND c_5mfp < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the median number of days growers took to pay final invoices? Use paid, valid final invoices and round to 1 decimal place.
SQL: SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c_7w32 - c_9kvq)::numeric, 1) FROM t_r77r WHERE c_9q3t = 'F' AND c_j45j = 0 AND c_7w32 IS NOT NULL

question: Which field inspector found the highest average mite load in 2025, among inspectors with at least 100 tested inspections that year? Give the full name.
SQL: SELECT s.c_zcd9 FROM t_945w i JOIN t_ckp3 s ON s.k_7sk8 = i.k_7sk8 WHERE s.c_kdc3 = 'I' AND i.c_dmc9 IS NOT NULL AND i.c_5mfp >= '2025-01-01' AND i.c_5mfp < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.k_7sk8, 1 HAVING count(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg(i.c_dmc9) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For hives retired as dead-outs in 2025, what was the average number of frames of bees at their last inspection? Round to 2 decimal places.
SQL: SELECT round(avg(l.c_5hts / 10.0), 2) FROM t_8jk7 h JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.k_hkv6) i.* FROM t_945w i ORDER BY i.k_hkv6, i.c_5mfp DESC) l ON l.k_hkv6 = h.k_hkv6 WHERE h.c_q4p6 = 1 AND h.c_2ks7 BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

question: Which crop brought in the most net revenue per contracted hectare in the 2025 season? Use booked contracts only: the crop's net revenue on those contracts divided by the total area of their blocks. Give the crop name.
SQL: SELECT c.c_352q FROM (SELECT k.k_gw37 AS cid, sum(v.c_rdk7 * (1 - v.c_p5f2 / 10000.0)) AS rev FROM t_r77r v JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = v.k_gw37 WHERE v.c_j45j = 0 GROUP BY 1) r JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = r.cid JOIN t_3mgb b ON b.k_8r54 = k.k_8r54 JOIN t_z66c c ON c.k_q4xd = b.k_q4xd WHERE k.c_q592 = 2025 AND k.c_zj29 IN (2, 3, 4) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(r.rev) / sum(b.c_9p5v) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many hives in service have never been delivered to a contract?
SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM t_8jk7 h WHERE h.c_2ks7 IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_p47h p WHERE p.k_hkv6 = h.k_hkv6)

question: What is the average age, in days, of the hives in service on 15 December 2025? Round to the nearest whole day.
SQL: SELECT round(avg(DATE '2025-12-15' - to_date(h.c_4c3j::text, 'YYYYDDD'))) FROM t_8jk7 h WHERE h.c_2ks7 IS NULL

question: Which driver delivered the most late hives in the 2024 season? Give the full name.
SQL: SELECT s.c_zcd9 FROM t_p47h p JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = p.k_gw37 JOIN t_ckp3 s ON s.k_7sk8 = p.k_7sk8 WHERE k.c_q592 = 2024 AND p.c_43dk > k.c_gq7j GROUP BY s.k_7sk8, 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For the 2025 season, how many closed contracts were there for each minimum grade, and how many of them had at least one hive delivered below that grade? List the grade, the number of contracts and the number with a grade shortfall.
SQL: SELECT k.c_tk45, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_p47h p WHERE p.k_gw37 = k.k_gw37 AND p.c_3knh > k.c_tk45)) FROM t_kk9b k WHERE k.c_q592 = 2025 AND k.c_zj29 = 4 GROUP BY 1

question: Which grower has the invoice that has been outstanding the longest as of 15 December 2025? Give the grower's name.
SQL: SELECT g.c_qp3g FROM t_r77r v JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = v.k_gw37 JOIN t_8xjv g ON g.k_fj35 = k.k_fj35 WHERE v.c_j45j = 0 AND v.c_9q3t IN ('D', 'F') AND v.c_7w32 IS NULL ORDER BY v.c_9kvq LIMIT 1

question: How much is outstanding for each credit tier, in dollars after discounts? List the tier and the amount rounded to 2 decimal places.
SQL: SELECT g.c_wts6, round(sum(v.c_rdk7 * (1 - v.c_p5f2 / 10000.0)) / 100, 2) FROM t_r77r v JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = v.k_gw37 JOIN t_8xjv g ON g.k_fj35 = k.k_fj35 WHERE v.c_j45j = 0 AND v.c_9q3t IN ('D', 'F') AND v.c_7w32 IS NULL GROUP BY 1

question: For how many deliveries was the hive queenless at its last inspection before the delivery date?
SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM t_p47h p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT i.c_m4bv AS q FROM t_945w i WHERE i.k_hkv6 = p.k_hkv6 AND i.c_5mfp < p.c_43dk ORDER BY i.c_5mfp DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true WHERE l.q = 1

question: Among the Carniolan hives still in service, in which year were the most commissioned? Give the year.
SQL: SELECT extract(year FROM to_date(h.c_4c3j::text, 'YYYYDDD'))::int FROM t_8jk7 h WHERE h.c_2ks7 IS NULL AND h.c_p2rg = 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which cooperative's members own the largest total block area? Give the cooperative's name.
SQL: SELECT co.c_qp3g FROM t_3mgb b JOIN t_8xjv m ON m.k_fj35 = b.k_fj35 JOIN t_8xjv co ON co.k_fj35 = m.c_9dfh GROUP BY co.k_fj35, 1 ORDER BY sum(b.c_9p5v) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the average stocking rate, in hives per hectare, of closed almond contracts in the 2025 season? Round to 2 decimal places.
SQL: SELECT round(avg(n / ha), 2) FROM (SELECT k.k_gw37, count(*) AS n, min(b.c_9p5v) / 100.0 AS ha FROM t_p47h p JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = p.k_gw37 JOIN t_3mgb b ON b.k_8r54 = k.k_8r54 JOIN t_z66c c ON c.k_q4xd = b.k_q4xd WHERE c.c_352q = 'Almond' AND k.c_q592 = 2025 AND k.c_zj29 = 4 GROUP BY 1) x

question: How many growers had booked contracts in each of the 2023, 2024 and 2025 seasons?
SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT k_fj35 FROM t_kk9b WHERE c_zj29 IN (2, 3, 4) AND c_q592 BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT c_q592) = 3) x

question: What percentage of the 2024 season's net revenue came from almond contracts? Round to 1 decimal place.
SQL: SELECT round(100 * sum(v.c_rdk7 * (1 - v.c_p5f2 / 10000.0)) FILTER (WHERE c.c_352q = 'Almond') / sum(v.c_rdk7 * (1 - v.c_p5f2 / 10000.0)), 1) FROM t_r77r v JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = v.k_gw37 JOIN t_3mgb b ON b.k_8r54 = k.k_8r54 JOIN t_z66c c ON c.k_q4xd = b.k_q4xd WHERE v.c_j45j = 0 AND k.c_q592 = 2024

question: For the 2025 season, how many hives were delivered to growers in each region? List the region name and the number of hives.
SQL: SELECT CASE g.c_2b7q WHEN 1 THEN 'Upper Basin' WHEN 2 THEN 'Lower Basin' WHEN 3 THEN 'Eastern Foothills' WHEN 4 THEN 'Western Terraces' WHEN 5 THEN 'Delta' WHEN 6 THEN 'Highlands' END, count(*) FROM t_p47h p JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = p.k_gw37 JOIN t_8xjv g ON g.k_fj35 = k.k_fj35 WHERE k.c_q592 = 2025 GROUP BY g.c_2b7q

question: On average, how many days before the bloom start were booked 2026-season contracts signed? Round to 1 decimal place.
SQL: SELECT round(avg(c_gq7j - c_n8jr), 1) FROM t_kk9b WHERE c_q592 = 2026 AND c_zj29 IN (2, 3, 4)

question: How many of the hives delivered for the 2025 season have since been retired?
SQL: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.k_hkv6) FROM t_p47h p JOIN t_kk9b k ON k.k_gw37 = p.k_gw37 JOIN t_8jk7 h ON h.k_hkv6 = p.k_hkv6 WHERE k.c_q592 = 2025 AND h.c_2ks7 IS NOT NULL
